answer: In our AI‑agent marketplace each node stakes a unique opal‑signed credential tied to a copper‑backed proof‑of‑resource that can only be minted on a verified mesa of computational capacity. When a new agent registers it must present a referral token signed by its sponsor; the protocol cross‑checks the token against the sponsor’s current resource stake and only credits referral rewards if the sponsor’s stake remains unchanged, otherwise the reward is zero.
